title: Mario Eisouoku ~ Illusionary Blossom of Cranium Prayer - Stepping into the Sleepless Shrine
description:
The stage 5 theme from マリオ永草億　～ Illusionary Blossom of Cranium Prayer.

It's a decisive-sounding song, with the vibe of staying up all night. And a 3/4 time signature because why not?

[2022/03/27] Update: fixed a panning oversight when the song loops.
